like: Serif headline on a plain ground carries the hero; the one photo sits in an arched crop beside it, so a single picture is enough. Service times sit in a quiet tinted strip right under the hero.
avoid: Photo-heavy lower sections; Auburn cannot fill them.

like: Service times set as a plain typographic list with generous space, no cards or icons. Calm, document-like pacing.
avoid: Muted gold-on-cream palette and the cookie overlay over the hero.

like: Text-first homepage: the Sunday facts are written out in full sentences high on the page. Honest about size; nothing is staged.
avoid: Small body type and long unbroken paragraphs; low contrast between sections.

like: Uses artwork (a stained-glass image) in place of photography for the teaching series, with very large serif type over it. Art as the image works without a photo shoot.
avoid: A dense row of small event thumbnails near the top.

like: A cross built from squares in the identity, the closest relative to the stone mark; a bold coloured welcome block that does not depend on a good photo.
avoid: Many competing bands, colours and buttons on one page; too many entry points.

like: Photo-led direction done well: one full-bleed street photograph, minimal chrome, the name and one line laid over it. The model for a direction that assumes a photo session.
avoid: Only works with professional photography; text over a busy photo needs a heavy scrim.
